svg.text: Coverage: how much of the object the reachable views face
1. Every direction the surface can face
2. Which ones a reachable camera faces
Each dot stands for the part of the surface
that faces that way: 345 directions, evenly
spread. The bottom rests on the table, so
directions more than 9° down are left out.
A camera on every planned view: dark if the arm
can reach it, crossed if not. A direction is seen
(green) when a reachable camera is within 55°
of it (the circle: the top view's 55°), else missed (red).
would look for a better spot on the table.
Illustrative: the real layout of planned views around a 30 × 30 × 60mm block, with the low and middle views on the side away from the arm out of reach.
